Bill's Message of the Day
The Strategy to Defeat President Trump
By:
Bill O'Reilly
July 20, 2020
Archive
Comment
Email
Print
It is now clear that the Democrats will try to ride the Covid epidemic into the White House come November.   The key to the strategy to defeat President Trump is to keep schools closed through this year.
If that happens in many places, the underlying signal will be the pandemic defeated the Trump administration. The President could not develop an effective containment policy and now the nation has to suffer through the fall.
At the same time, the anti-Trump media will continue blaming Donald Trump for the catastrophe itself. The contagion is all his fault will be pounded home by the New York Times, the Washington Post, CNN, and NBC News among others.
This will be a tough fight for President Trump. The teacher’s unions will support keeping the schools shut because they always align with the democrats. It will get nasty in September.
President Trump should point all this out to the American people and should also take advice from countries in Europe that have opened schools. Scientists say children are least affected by Covid and Mr. Trump should use as much “science “ as he can.
At this point, the President isn’t really running against Joe Biden. He’s running against a virus.
Now this.
Tonight we’ll have more on Covid politics. And analyze the President’s interview with Chris Wallace. See you for the newscast beginning at six eastern.
